subtasks.description:
Add tests for a new DeleteTask() method on Orchestrator that deletes a root task along with all its subtasks, agents, comments, and events. Tests should cover:
1. Deleting a root task with no subtasks (deletes task, its comments, its events)
2. Deleting a root task with subtasks (cascades: stops agents, deletes subtask comments/events, deletes subtasks, then deletes parent task comments/events and the task itself)
3. Attempting to delete a non-existent task (returns error)
4. Deleting a subtask directly via DeleteTask (should work the same as DeleteSubtask — delegates to existing DeleteSubtask method)

Follow the existing test pattern in lifecycle_test.go using setupLifecycleTest() and lifecycleTestDB(). Tests should initially fail since DeleteTask doesn't exist yet.

IMPORTANT: DeleteTask will live in internal/orchestrator/lifecycle.go (a new file), NOT in orchestrator.go.
subtasks.title: Write tests for DeleteTask orchestrator method

subtasks.description:
Create a new file internal/orchestrator/lifecycle.go and:

1. MOVE the following methods from orchestrator.go into lifecycle.go (this shrinks orchestrator.go which has a shrink-only constraint):
   - DeleteSubtask()
   - DeleteComment()
   - DeletePlanStep()

2. ADD a new DeleteTask(taskID uuid.UUID) method in lifecycle.go:
   a. Load the task by ID (return error if not found)
   b. If the task has a ParentTaskID (it's a subtask), delegate to the existing DeleteSubtask() method
   c. If it's a root task:
      - Load all subtasks (WHERE parent_task_id = taskID)
      - For each subtask, call DeleteSubtask() to handle agent cleanup, comment/event deletion
      - Delete the root task's own comments and events
      - Delete the root task record itself
      - Emit 'task_updated' event

This reuses DeleteSubtask() for agent lifecycle management. The move to lifecycle.go respects the shrink-only constraint on orchestrator.go (baseline: 2917 lines, must not grow).
subtasks.title: Implement DeleteTask and extract deletion methods to lifecycle.go

subtasks.description:
Add tests in detail_test.go verifying that:
1. deletableItems() includes a deleteItemTask entry for the selected task (as the LAST item, after plan steps and comments)
2. When the task is a subtask (ParentTaskID != nil), it still appears as a deletable item
3. The deleteItemTask kind is correctly identified by isDeleteTarget() and isDeleteSection()
4. The task deletion item appears regardless of task status (unlike plan steps which only appear in plan_review)

Follow the existing table-driven test pattern in detail_test.go.
subtasks.title: Write tests for TUI task deletion in delete mode

subtasks.description:
Extend the existing delete mode in the TUI to support deleting the selected task or subtask:

1. In detail.go:
   - Add deleteItemTask to the deleteItemKind enum
   - In deletableItems(), append a deleteItemTask entry as the last item (always present when a task is selected)
   - In the View rendering, show the task deletion option in delete mode (e.g., render it with a label like '× Delete task' or '× Delete subtask' depending on ParentTaskID)

2. In app.go:
   - In handleDeleteModeKeys(), add a case for deleteItemTask in the switch on item.kind
   - If the task is a subtask (ParentTaskID != nil), call orch.DeleteSubtask(taskID)
   - If the task is a root task, call orch.DeleteTask(taskID)
   - Run deletion async (same pattern as existing deleteItemComment/deleteItemPlanStep)
   - After deletion, refresh data to update the board

The existing 'd' -> delete mode -> select item -> 'y'/'enter' flow provides the confirmation UX naturally.
subtasks.title: Implement TUI task/subtask deletion via delete mode
